summary: Obfuscated remote-code dropper executes fetched payload on require()
details: index.js is a heavily obfuscated IIFE (312-entry base64+RC4 string array, hex-numeric literals, array-rotation self-check) whose only behavior on module load is a fetch-decrypt-write-execute chain. It requires path, os, fs, child_process, crypto and https; assembles a bare-IP URL by joining four numeric octets with '.', issues an https/http GET to that host, splits the response on ':' into an IV and ciphertext, AES-decrypts the ciphertext with a KDF-derived key, writes the plaintext to a file under os.tmpdir(), and runs it via child_process.execSync with cwd set to the temp directory and windowsHide:true. The obfuscation exists solely to hide this chain; the package has no other functionality despite its name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
